products.body_html:

Wear it with mostly everything. Fatherhood not required.

One size fits most.

products.title: Five-Panel Patch Hat
products.body_html:

Wear it during any round or throw it on for everyday wear.

products.title: Single Button Polo Pullover
products.body_html:
The layer that doesn't look like every other quarter-zip.

We wanted something that could handle a round without looking like traditional golf outerwear. The textured fabric has enough stretch to swing comfortably, with a clean single-button collar and midweight feel that works layered over a polo or worn on its own.

96% Polyester / 4% Spandex

 

  • Modern fit with clean lines through the chest and shoulders
  • Midweight construction designed to layer or wear on its own
  • Single-button collar for a cleaner alternative to the traditional quarter-zip
  • Runs true to size
  • Machine wash cold, tumble dry low

Model is 5'11", wearing a size Large and loves a steakhouse Old Fashioned.

products.title: Ottoman Camp Collar Polo
products.body_html:
We loved how activewear performed. We just didn't want to dress like it.

So we created a lightweight ottoman knit with the stretch and breathability you want for a warm round, without looking like another performance polo. The textured finish and relaxed camp collar make it just as easy to wear when you're nowhere near a golf course.

75% Cotton / 25% Nylon

• Relaxed fit with room through the chest and shoulders
• Camp collar designed to sit flat without feeling stiff
• Length designed to wear tucked or untucked
• Runs true to size — size up for extra room
• Machine wash cold, tumble dry low

Model is 5'11" , wearing a size Large and swears he doesn't have a Boston accent.

products.title: Resort Camp Collar Polo
products.body_html:
A resort shirt made to play 18. We took the relaxed silhouette and camp collar of a classic resort shirt and rebuilt it as a golf polo. The custom textured knit has plenty of stretch, while the easy fit works just as well with shorts on the back nine as it does with linen pants at dinner.

69% Cotton / 31% Polyester

  • Relaxed fit with room through the chest and shoulders
  • Camp collar designed to sit flat without feeling stiff
  • Length designed to wear tucked or untucked
  • Runs slightly large — size down for a closer fit
  • Machine wash cold, tumble dry low

Model is 5'11" , wearing a size Medium and lives in Cape Cod during the summer.

products.title: Relaxed Fit Textured Crew
products.body_html:
Not your standard crewneck.

We built this one with a custom double-layer fabric — textured on the outside, smooth and stretchy on the inside. Substantial enough for cooler days without feeling stiff, with a relaxed fit that works over a polo or just as easily with jeans.

55% Cotton / 40% Polyester / 5% Spandex

  • Relaxed fit with room through the chest
  • Ribbed cuffs and hem keep the silhouette clean
  • Runs slightly large — stay true to size for a relaxed fit or size down for a closer fit
  • Machine wash cold, tumble dry low

Model is 5'11" wearing a large and has dreams of retiring early on Lake Como
